title: Pattern masks
text: Digits, letters, alphanumerics, escapes, and custom tokens with transforms such as upper case.

title: Presets
text: Phone, IBAN, ZIP, and ISO date shapes ready to spread into the options.

title: Raw or formatted
text: value is the raw text, formattedValue adds the literals; submit either one.

title: Caret and paste
text: Paste fills the slots, Backspace skips literals, and the caret stays where you expect.

title: Screen-reader friendly
text: A generated format hint is read with the field; placeholders never enter the value.
